preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of blocks in the zebra crossing is between 2 and 10^3 inclusive.
The number of jumps Chef can make is between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either a valid block number or -1.
The output is -1 if Chef cannot make exactly K jumps, otherwise it is a block number that Chef can reach.
